fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 48% match is a WEAK FIT for this Senior Software Engineer role on Cloudflare's Egress team.

**Strengths:**
- 11 years of backend engineering in Java, Kotlin and Python
- Ran a Kafka settlement service handling about 40 million events daily
- Led 4 engineers through a 9 month monolith-to-services migration

**Gaps:**
- No Go or Rust, both core requirements
- No Layer 3/4 networking, TLS, CDN or VPN experience
- No Kubernetes, ClickHouse or Grafana

**Recommendation:** Build a small Go or Rust networking project (for example a TCP or TLS proxy) before applying, then lead your application with your distributed systems and on-call experience.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Cloudflare

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Egress team owns connectivity for products like WARP and the iCloud Private Relay egress proxy, which means a slow or failing path hurts every product built on top. I know that kind of pressure from payments. At Lumen Payments I designed and ran a settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot that processed about 40 million events a day on Kafka, and I cut p99 latency on our payment status API from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis.

You're asking for someone who owns production-critical distributed systems end to end and is a technical escalation point. In 11 years of building payment and event-processing services, I've done that through API design, event-driven architecture and code review. I led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, and I was on call for the payments platform, writing post-incident reviews for 14 incidents. I haven't worked in Go or Rust professionally, and I haven't done Layer 3 and 4 networking work. I'm a builder who learns quickly, and I'm keen to take on that work with your Run What You Build model.

I'm returning to full-time engineering after a career break, during which I earned my AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate certification (2024). I'd welcome a conversation about how I can contribute to the Egress team, and I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Best regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your Egress team needs someone to own production-critical distributed systems and lead beyond their own code, and at Lumen Payments I designed and ran a settlement service processing about 40 million events a day on Kafka, then led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services. I was on call for the payments platform and wrote the post-incident reviews for 14 incidents, so I know what it takes to keep critical systems reliable. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available for a conversation at your convenience, and I could start within a few weeks of an offer.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
